lines.trans: The night air is cool.
Paris is magnificent at this hour.
Where are you going to go tonight?
I am going home quietly.
And me, I am joining my family.
Take good care of your daughter.
Flora grows up so fast already.
You will be an admirable mother.
And you, an excellent screenwriter!
We call each other tomorrow morning?
